svg.text: F. The staff call console: one caller, one screen
Same three server functions as the shop, with the channel marked "staff_console" and the caller's member code attached.
The session gate runs before anything else
No valid staff token means an immediate redirect to the sign-in
page, and not one database call is made. The token was signed by
the server; the browser cannot mint or edit one.
Caller lookup
A member number or a name. GW-000002, gw2, 000002 and 2 all
resolve to the same account. A slash key jumps back here from
anywhere, and Enter picks the top match.
Caller snapshot and call notes
Volume figures come from the same public demonstration views the
member portal reads. Contact details are synthesized from the
member code, deterministically, so nothing personal is stored.
Quick order
Product, billing mode, quantity, add line. The same catalog file
the shop uses. Phone orders carry no activation fee and the
activation is always standard.
Confirmation, written to be read aloud
The order number is spelled out phonetically, the total is spelled
out in words, and the qualification line tells the agent whether
this order qualifies the caller's month. The agent reads the
screen; they do not have to compose anything.
Three payment choices, and the truth about each
Payment link to the caller's own device (recommended)
The right habit: the caller pays on their own phone, so a bank
approval can actually happen and no card number is spoken aloud.
Disabled today, with the reason stated: minting a hosted link needs
a server function that has not been built.
Key the card here, a telephone order
The working path today. The card goes into the provider's secure
form, never into this page's own fields.
Card on file: a labelled demonstration, permanently disabled
The rules printed on the screen, not buried in a manual
1. Never ask a caller to read out a code their bank sent. That request
is word for word the script of a real fraud technique, and it does not
complete the approval anyway.
2. If the bank asks for an approval, only the cardholder can give it, on
their own device. The console says so plainly instead of inviting help.
3. A keyed card is a telephone order. It sits outside Strong Customer
Authentication (SCA), so the fraud liability lands on us, not the issuer.
Same rails as the shop
create-payment opens the order and returns the confirmation number,
which the agent gives the caller before anything else can go wrong.
confirm-payment is the only source of the outcome. The console has its
own resume state, its own abandon control, and its own order lookup.
Tax parity with the shop, closed 2026-08-15
The console now calls quote-tax, sends the tax identifier as text, and paints
calculated, estimate or flat. Measured on caller GW-000003: $8.88 tax and
$108.88 total on screen, on the button, and on the server row. Was $105.00.
Sources: www/staff.html, www/login.html, functions/create-payment/index.ts, functions/confirm-payment/index.ts
